info.title: API.SH: Hacker News
info.description: The Hacker News API from API.SH: public Hacker News data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Full-text search of Hacker News stories and comments: title, URL, text, author, points, comment count, time, parent and story ids and a link to the discussion. Filter by tags (story, comment, poll, job, ask_hn, show_hn, front_page), author, one story's thread, a date range, minimum points or comments; sort by relevance or by date (newest first). `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hackernews-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Words to search for in titles, URLs and comment text. Leave empty with filters to list by date.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated filters, all must match: story, comment, poll, job, ask_hn, show_hn, front_page.

parameters.name: story_id
parameters.description: Only comments and the story in this story's thread.

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.description: Only items with at least this many points.

parameters.name: min_comments
parameters.description: Only items with at least this many comments.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The ids of items and the usernames of profiles that changed in the last moments (new comments, edits, score changes). expand=true adds each changed item (up to 50) with its type, author, title, text and points.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hackernews-updates

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: true adds the changed items' details (up to 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Hacker News user's profile: username, karma, about (plain and HTML), account creation time, the total number of submissions, and their `submitted` item ids (stories, comments, polls, jobs), newest first. Page through them with `page` and `limit`; pass `expand=true` to get each item's title, URL, text, points, comment count and time instead of only ids (up to 30 per page). `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hackernews-user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Submitted ids per page (default 50, max 500; with `expand`, default and max 30).

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: true to include each submitted item's details.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A user's stories, comments, Ask HN, Show HN, polls or jobs, newest first (or by relevance with `query`), each with title, link, text, points, comment count and the story a comment belongs to. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hackernews-user-submissions

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: all (default), story, comment, ask, show, poll or job.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only items from this day on (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only items up to this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.description: Only items with at least this many points.

parameters.name: min_comments
parameters.description: Only stories with at least this many comments.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
